_about: Live discount codes for the preview checkout (audit B C1, 2026-10-17). LIT35 is the code the announcement bar and the first-order popup advertise (owner changed 10% to 35% on 2026-10-18; LIT10 stays valid until switched off in Shopify). On Shopify the real discount lives in Shopify admin (Discounts) with the same code; this file only drives the static preview. Same shape as qa/fixtures/codes.json, which stays for the QA matrix.
